prompt: Create a website for a silent yoga retreat in Marin for December 2, 2026.
summary: A one-day silent yoga retreat in Marin County on December 2, 2026 needs a simple, calm landing page presenting the schedule, location, pricing, and a registration call-to-action. Since there's no need for accounts, persistent user data, or server-side logic (registration can link out to email or an external form/payment link), a single static site fully serves this brief with no backend or database required.

services.name: marin-silent-retreat
services.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp *.html style.css dist/ && cp -r assets dist/
